changes.title: Station rework
items: Every treehouse station menu now fits on the screen: no more scrolling
New basin by the bed: skin tone, makeup (lipstick, eyeshadow, blush) and a button to brush your teeth
Each station holds fewer things: hair, sunglasses and earrings at the dressing table; jacket and top on the wardrobe rail; trousers and shoes at the shoe rack
Bags show as small cards; the one you're on shows how it throws, with its firing preview
Smaller colour swatches, and what you're wearing is clearly marked, even on pale colours
Things you haven't found yet show as grey shapes, no padlocks
Menus open on what you're wearing, and the camera frames the part of you each station changes
Guest bedrooms get their own basin and shoe rack
The DJ booth matches the other menus, and its prompt hides while it's open
Your first morning starts at the basin, then the dressing table
A new witch starts with light green skin

changes.title: Broom stations
items: Take your broom for the night from the new broom rack
Your broom is modded at three stations: tips at the new workbench, the body at the lathe, exhausts at the new hydraulic lift
The broom stations only light up while you're carrying your broom, and show it on the vice, lathe or lift
Each broom station fits on the screen, with your sets and your broom's stats at the bottom
The pegboard is now just for show: your finds hang on it
The hydraulic lift hisses up and down

changes.title: Bed pose
items: In bed she sits up on the mattress, facing the foot of the bed, instead of standing in the middle of it; her stretch as she gets up is in bed too
In bed the duvet covers her legs, in the bed's own colours
In bed her nightie no longer glows to a white blob: her own glow and the bloom are softened until she's up

changes.title: Tree normal directions
items: The pause page's Tree normal maps test switch is now a choice: full, 64, 32 or 16 directions, or off. The reduced ones cut each tree atlas's normal map to that many directions, to judge how few the trees can keep and still look right. Full stays the default.
